My beans do not need plenty of chemical fertilizer — the plant feeds the soil itself, and I am also planting other crops with it on this small piece of land. I have no money to waste on urea for beans. But the insects, they will finish my cowpea if I do not spray, so I will buy small pesticide when the flowers come. I will do most of the work myself with my children, and call two or three people only for weeding and harvest.
